standards.summaryText: Investigate and interpret diversity among species and within species, and describe how diversity contributes to species survival
standards.officialOutcomeText: Investigate and interpret diversity among species and within species, and describe how diversity contributes to species survival
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explore and explain diversity among species and within species, and explain how diversity contributes to species survival.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 1

standards.summaryText: Investigate the nature of reproductive processes and their role in transmitting species characteristics
standards.officialOutcomeText: Investigate the nature of reproductive processes and their role in transmitting species characteristics
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explore the nature of reproductive processes and their role in transmitting species characteristics.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 2

standards.summaryText: Describe, in general terms, the role of genetic materials in the continuity and variation of species characteristics; and investigate and interpret related technologies
standards.officialOutcomeText: Describe, in general terms, the role of genetic materials in the continuity and variation of species characteristics; and investigate and interpret related technologies
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students explain, in general terms, the role of genetic materials in the continuity and variation of species characteristics; and explore and explain related technologies.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 3

standards.summaryText: Identify impacts of human action on species survival and variation within species, and analyze related issues for personal and public decision making
standards.officialOutcomeText: Identify impacts of human action on species survival and variation within species, and analyze related issues for personal and public decision making
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students recognize impacts of human action on species survival and variation within species, and analyze related issues for personal and public decision making.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Outcomes for Science, Technology and Society (STS) and Knowledge > Specific Outcome 4

standards.summaryText: Ask questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions
standards.officialOutcomeText: Ask questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build initiating and planning science skills by asking questions about the relationships between and among observable variables, and plan investigations to address those questions.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Conduct investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data
standards.officialOutcomeText: Conduct investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build performing and recording science skills by conducting investigations into the relationships between and among observations, and gather and record qualitative and quantitative data.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and assess possible explanations
standards.officialOutcomeText: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and assess possible explanations
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build analyzing and interpreting science skills by analyzing qualitative and quantitative data, and develop and evaluate possible explanations.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Work collaboratively on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results
standards.officialOutcomeText: Work collaboratively on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students build communication and teamwork science skills by collaborating on problems; and use appropriate language and formats to communicate ideas, procedures and results.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Skill Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Show interest in science-related questions and issues, and confidently pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields (e.g., select and explore media on topics related to species diversity; express interest in hobbies and careers that involve the care, culture and study of living things)
standards.officialOutcomeText: Show interest in science-related questions and issues, and confidently pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields (e.g., select and explore media on topics related to species diversity; express interest in hobbies and careers that involve the care, culture and study of living things)
standards.curriculumFocus: In Unit A, students develop science learning dispositions by engaging with science-related questions and issues, and confidently pursue personal interests and career possibilities within science-related fields.
standards.sourceLocator: SCIGEN_79 > SCN9 > Unit A: Biological Diversity > Attitude Outcomes > Specific Outcome

standards.summaryText: Appreciate that scientific understanding evolves from the interaction of ideas involving people with different views and backgrounds (e.g., show awareness that the scientific study of changing animal and plant populations can arise from a variety of global needs, involving many individuals and organizations)
standards.officialOutcomeText: Appreciate that scientific understanding evolves from the interaction of ideas involving people with different views and backgrounds (e.g., show awareness that the scientific study of changing animal and plant populations can arise from a variety of global needs, involving many individuals and organizations)
